correctness.rationale: Fourier characters simultaneously diagonalize both real quadratic energies after complexification. The long multiplier is 4r/n and the sign multiplier is 2(1-product cos). For even m, absolute cosine bounds and monotonicity of r/(1-c^r) force the maximum at r=n with minimal odd frequency, giving the exact value. A real extremizer exists in the real span of an extremizing character and its conjugate. Quotient duality, normalization, and the asymptotic are then exact. Boundary m=2 is handled separately; finite computations are only sanity checks.
